digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate (pass-1 advisory criteria + bug review tier)
propositions: Plan reviews lack a criterion to assess whether a proposed change is actually needed, leading to 35-65% over-action rate where mechanisms are added without demonstrated necessity
Bug tickets currently bypass substantive plan review entirely via exempt-PASS short-circuit in workflow_ops.plan_review_precheck, receiving no DET floor or LLM analysis
The necessity advisory criterion must flag plans that fail to reproduce or motivate the problem, while accepting well-motivated no-op and docs-test-only outcomes
Bugs should receive a lightweight advisory review tier consisting of the DET floor and necessity probe only, never blocking the bug, instead of bare exempt-PASS
The necessity criterion and bug review tier must be registered non-orphan in criteria_routing.json and registry.py with advisory posture and auto-monitored via the standing effectiveness recorder
